package com.acme.notify.template;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Minimal "{{placeholder}}" renderer for notification e-mails and SMS.
 *
 * <pre>
 *   renderer.render("Hi {{name}}; your order {{orderId}} shipped", Map.of("name", "Ana", "orderId", "A-1"))
 * </pre>
 */
public class TemplateRenderer {

    private static final Pattern PLACEHOLDER = Pattern.compile("\\{\\{\\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_.]+)\\s*}}");

    private final Map<String, Function<String, String>> filters = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final boolean strict;

    public TemplateRenderer(final boolean strict) {
        this.strict = strict;
        filters.put("upper", String::toUpperCase);
        filters.put("trim", String::trim);
    }

    public String render(final String template, final Map<String, ?> model) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(template, "template");
        Matcher m = PLACEHOLDER.matcher(template);
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        while (m.find()) {
            String key = m.group(1);
            Object value = model.get(key);
            if (value == null && strict) {
                throw new MissingPlaceholderException(key);
            }
            m.appendReplacement(out, Matcher.quoteReplacement(value == null ? "" : value.toString()));
        }
        m.appendTail(out);
        return out.toString();
    }

    /** Groups templates by channel, e.g. {"EMAIL": [reset, welcome], "SMS": [otp]}. */
    public static Map<String, List<Item>> byChannel(final Item... items) {
        Map<String, List<Item>> grouped = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Item item : items) {
            grouped.computeIfAbsent(item.channel(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item);
        }
        grouped.values().forEach(list -> Collections.sort(list, new Comparator<Item>() {
            @Override
            public int compare(final Item a, final Item b) {
                return a.name().compareToIgnoreCase(b.name());
            }
        }));
        return grouped;
    }

    public String applyFilter(final String filterName, final String input) {
        Function<String, String> f = filters.getOrDefault(filterName, Function.identity());
        return f.apply(input);
    }

    public String[] placeholders(final String template) {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        Matcher m = PLACEHOLDER.matcher(template);
        while (m.find()) {
            names.add(m.group(1));
        }
        return names.toArray(new String[0]);
    }

    /** A named template on a delivery channel. */
    public static final class Item {
        private final String name;
        private final String channel;

        public Item(final String name, final String channel) {
            this.name = name;
            this.channel = channel;
        }

        public String name() {
            return name;
        }

        public String channel() {
            return channel;
        }
    }

    /** Thrown in strict mode when the model has no value for a placeholder. */
    public static class MissingPlaceholderException extends RuntimeException {
        public MissingPlaceholderException(final String key) {
            super("No value for placeholder '" + key + "'");
        }
    }
}
